data.one_liner: Provides useful extensions and helper functions for Dart types to speed up development.
data.what_it_does: Adds extension methods, helper functions, and classes to common Dart types like String, Int, Map, DateTime, Future, and IO classes. It includes utilities for parsing, scoping, and collection manipulation.
use_when: You want shortcut extension methods on primitive types and collections
You need convenient scope functions like apply and run
You want helper methods for handling files, directories, and futures
avoid_when: You prefer keeping your core types clean without extension clutter
You only need specific utilities that can be imported from smaller focused packages
strengths: Comprehensive collection of over 300 extensions and helpers
Includes bundled collection and IO extensions
weaknesses: Large extension scope might pollute autocompletion suggestions
Contains breaking changes across minor versions
